title: Not Eligible | ASL | Denied Boarding
description:
Passenger denied boarding on an Israel route. Denied boarding is handled under SEPARATE ASL provisions � not the flight disruption compensation flow. Same scope exclusion as APPR TC_044 (NE-06). Customer redirected to the correct denied boarding process. The case is logged as "Not Eligible (Flight Disruption)" � the customer MAY be eligible under denied boarding provisions through a different channel.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger. Journey: Israel route (AC operated). Trip Tracer Flag: DENIED BOARDING EVENT = TRUE. Flight status: Flight operated but customer was NOT aboard.
